description: Set value(s) on an autocomplete/combobox input. Handles the click → type query → wait for filtered listbox → click option flow as one MCP call. Supports multi-select (e.g., Languages on Meta Ads). Use when browser_select_option fails because options render lazily after typing.

multi.description: True if combobox accepts multiple values (chips). Default: auto-detected from presence of values array

query_chars.description: How many characters to type as filter query (default: 4 or full value length, whichever is smaller)

selector.description: CSS selector for the combobox/autocomplete input

value.description: Single value to select (use this OR values)

values.description: Array of values for multi-select. E.g. ["Danish", "English", "Swedish"]

wait_ms.description: Max ms to wait for options listbox to appear after typing (default: 3000)

name: browser_set_combobox
